notes.title: END OF BETA #2: THANK YOU ALL!
notes.content:
END OF BETA #2: THANK YOU ALL!Some fun numbers to kick things off:
33,526 runs played

8,643 hours of playtime (≈ 360 days of non-stop battles!)

That’s incredible. We’re blown away by your support! Thanks to you, we stress-tested the game and gathered tons of feedback.



We’ve just finished going through most of your feedback and bug reports. If you still have ideas, critiques, or suggestions, please keep them coming!

Survey: Link

Discord: Join us


Here’s a sneak peek at some of the stuff we’ll be adjusting and improving based on your playtest feedback.
[hr][/hr]Gilles the Hog 
So… that boss was hard, huh? Sorry!!! We added a last-minute broken system that scaled difficulty with the threat bar. The result? Gilles turned into a bullet sponge with huge HP and brutal one-shot hits. That’s on us, and it’s getting fixed.

We’re also reworking his behavior and stats to make the fight more engaging and up-close. Expect less running in circles and more real clashes.


[hr][/hr]Emblems
Some content missing in the beta/demo is pretty obvious (characters, enemies, etc.), but let’s talk quickly about Emblems.

In the beta/demo you only saw 4 incomplete families, including tier 1 and some tier 2 Emblems. 

In the full game, there will be 8 base families, each with emblem tiers going from 1 to 3, and each also having unique Emblems for synergies with other families.

So for now, in the version you tried out, the Emblems pool is smaller and more focused than what is to be expected. We’ll also be rebalancing existing emblems (yes, Orbs, we see you).


[hr][/hr]Healing
You asked for it, and we agree: there will be more ways to heal.


[hr][/hr]And so much more…
From your feedback alone, we logged 231 new tasks (not even counting bug reports). Expect a lot of meaningful improvements coming your way.


[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for diving into Tears of Metal. Your support means the world to us.

See you soon!


 – blankfox

notes.title: Tears of Metal – Open Beta #2 - Aug 30- Sept 1st
notes.content:
Tears of Metal – Open Beta #2 is Live!⚔️
We’re back! Join us this weekend for an open playtest of the first part of the game.

   
🎯 Focus: Multiplayer Testing
The main thing we need your help with right now is Multiplayer.
We’ve been working hard to smooth out the online experience, so your feedback here is critical!



✅ Invite your friends
✅ Find teammates on our Discord.



💬 The best place to report issues or drop feedback is our Discord. We’ve set up dedicated channels just for the beta. 


🔥 What’s in the Beta?
The current beta is a distilled version of Act 1. It features a focus version of what’s to come in the upcoming demo.


⚔️ Update / Patch Notes
(non-exhaustive. It’s been a while!)
New Content
Weapon Combo Kit

Roam after victory

Emblems rework

Threat & Hazards system

New objectives

New unlockable content

Company system

and more!
Quality of Life
Keyboard controls refined → as snappy as controller

Parry is now an AoE effect

Enemy behavior tweaks & balancing

Fixed “false” attack button input

Content % tracker
Design Tweaks & Rebalancing
Charms are more impactful

Charms are now purchased, not granted by objectives

Ally Emblems persist across runs (until that ally dies)

Multiplayer balance improvements

Act 1 pacing & overall duration adjusted

…and much more!




🎮 Join the Beta Now!
Access the beta is from the main store page.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913120/Tears_of_Metal/"][/dynamiclink]

We can’t wait to hear what you think, especially about Multiplayer. Thanks for helping us make the game better!



Cheers, 



-blankfox

notes.title: Tears of Metal – Open Beta - April 10-17
notes.content:
Tears of Metal – Open Beta is Live!⚔️
As revealed today during the Triple-i Interactive Showcase, we’re thrilled to open the gates to our very first public Open Beta, running from April 10th to April 17th! This is your chance to dive into the chaos early and help shape the future of Tears of Metal.

📺 Watch the new Trailer:
[previewyoutube=PLr5k1FKGAw;full][/previewyoutube]



🎯 What’s the Goal of the Beta?
This beta is the foundation for what will become the first Act. Here’s what we’re hoping to achieve with your help:

-Gameplay Feedback – Let us know what you love, what feels off, and what could be better. Your feedback is crucial in helping us sharpen the experience.
-Bug Reports – The beta still has some rough edges, and we expect a few bumps. If you hit a bug or crash, we most definitely want to hear about it!


💬 The best place to report issues or drop feedback is our Discord. We’ve set up dedicated channels just for the beta.

🔧 Expect patches and updates throughout the week as we respond to feedback and fix bugs!

🔥 What’s in the Beta?
The current beta is a distilled version of Act 1. It features a focus version of what’s to come in the full experience.

Here's what you'll find:
-Around 12x enemies
-1x Boss fight
-20x Charms to experiment with
-4x Emblem families to explore
-A touch of meta progression in the Village
-Secrets and unlockables to reward multiple playthroughs


All of this will evolve into our full demo, so we want to know what works and what doesn’t.

🎮 Join the Beta Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913120/Tears_of_Metal/

Thank you so much for being part of this. Your support means so much to us. We are really excited to see what you all think!

Cheers,
-blankfox

notes.title: Working on the demo!
notes.content:
Hello! I’m Raph, co-founder and creative director of Tears of Metal. Here’s some updates on our project.

Hard at work on the Demo + Demo testers needed
We’re currently developing our public demo, which will mark a significant milestone for us! We're targeting a demo release date in December or January.

To ensure the demo is the best it can be, we need enthusiastic testers to provide feedback. If you’re interested in becoming a playtester for the demo (and the game), the best way to stay informed is to join our Discord. We’ll be announcing recruitment there once we're ready.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050868/355aaa1393590d9d542865f91b38ce697dc2c0f7.png


Summer Game Fest + PAX West
Our reveal at Summer Game Fest exceeded all our expectations! We hit 100,000 wishlists within the first week of our announcement, which has been an incredible morale booster. Thank you so much for your support! <3 

We also had the pleasure of meeting many of you at PAX West at the end of August. This was our first public showcase of the game, and we couldn't be happier with how it went. It was nerve-wracking to see players excited about the trailer and eager to experience the game for the first time. The reactions were overwhelmingly positive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050868/f28b1c2a6f04c89240058ddb67545484762d9a7f.jpg

Extra goodies:
Our audio team at SIDE Montréal produced a fantastic edit showcasing their work on the trailer:

[previewyoutube=M0iEgXMssbc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
